uncomposed room, read whole through its forest (2 threads coded of 129; 52 read in full, 77 triaged, 127 out of scope; 13 concepts in 4 themes): picturegame, does-not-compose by both readers, no ruling changes it. What it did: in an emoji-nominations thread (h4 to h42) members propose emojis, and c0003 bases one on a kiwi figure seen on the canvas to stand for the game's teamwork; on April Fools (h22.7 to h23.7) the room plays a sound-only round of its guessing game, a deaf player asks for help and gets a picture hint, a guess is marked correct, and the moderator bot invites players to the game's chat. No member calls, starts, builds, keeps or defends canvas work in the record. What the model would need: an account of a room's own game on the joke day, which is not canvas organizing; the one canvas act, a figure kept as an emblem, is P13's. Should the model have it: no; the model is about organizing canvas work, and the room's play is the sub's own business that D3a-55 ruled outside the scope in 387 propose lines. Kind (mine): out-of-scope, the room played; it bounds the model's scope, not its claims. The condition that separates it from the rooms that compose: its record holds no act on canvas work of its own, only a figure already on the canvas taken as an emoji. Next: uncomposed-D.md
